summary: A file locus's exclude admits a directory, which leaves every path beneath it ungoverned
acceptance: a kind excluding a directory loads, and no path beneath that directory is discovered or bound as its member
tests: an excluded directory leaves every path beneath it ungoverned

notes: One membership home stays locus_admits (discovery, check, emit, coverage, both guard edges all route through it). Spelling of the directory form (trailing `/` or bare prefix) is build's call; keep it starless.
